title: Order Service Database Pool Starvation
raw_logs:
[2026-09-24T10:14:02Z] ERROR order_service.db: sqlalchemy.exc.TimeoutError: QueuePool limit of size 5 overflow 10 reached, connection timed out, timeout 30.00
[2026-09-24T10:14:05Z] CRITICAL order_service.checkout: Failed to acquire database transaction for checkout_id=ord_8923
[2026-09-24T10:14:09Z] WARN order_service.health: /healthz liveness probe responded with HTTP 503 Service Unavailable

ground_truth.root_cause: Deployment v2.4.1 reduced max database pool connections from 20 to 5, leading to starvation under peak checkout traffic.
ground_truth.remediation: Increase POOL_SIZE to 25 and set POOL_TIMEOUT to 10
